capabilities: Edit kanban boards with drag-and-drop cards, lane reordering, and multi-select
Record per-card lane move history as a hidden comment ledger in the board file
Manage cards with tri-state checkboxes, tags, due-date chips, and an archive
Search boards and undo/redo board changes
Read and write the Kanban plugin's Markdown board file format
extras: Desktop only for now (mobile planned; the original Kanban plugin reads the same files in the meantime). Boards edited by the original Kanban plugin lose the move-history ledger, so Boardwalk mirrors history into its own plugin data and offers a one-click restore. Installable via BRAT or manual file copy.
intentEvidence: Boardwalk is a from-scratch reimplementation of the subset that matters most to its author
motivation: The author wanted the subset of the original Kanban plugin that mattered most to them, rebuilt from scratch, plus features the original never shipped such as per-card move history.
problem: The established Kanban plugin is effectively unmaintained since mid-2024, and it never offered move history, multi-select, or board-level undo.

relations.evidence: Boardwalk reads and writes the same Markdown board format as the Kanban plugin by mgmeyers
BRAT: add this repository in BRAT

summary: Kanban board plugin that renders Markdown lists as drag-and-drop boards with per-card move history, due dates, and multi-select.
